speaker: dvm
text: Hi. This is Max's third chemo treatment for his multicentric lymphoma. How has he been since last week?

speaker: client
text: Pretty good. He was a bit tired for a day, and had soft stool once, but he ate normally.

speaker: dvm
text: He weighs thirty point two kilos, so his body surface area is about one square metre. Temperature thirty-eight point four.

speaker: dvm
text: His lymph nodes are much smaller. The left mandibular node measures about one and a half centimetres, down from four.

speaker: dvm
text: Bloodwork is fine to treat. Neutrophils are three point one.

speaker: dvm
text: So he's in partial remission. That's grade one diarrhoea, which is mild.

speaker: dvm
text: Today he gets vincristine, point seven milligrams per square metre IV, as a slow push.

speaker: dvm
text: He goes home with prednisone, twenty milligrams by mouth once a day, and maropitant if he gets nauseous.

speaker: client
text: He's still playing ball every day, so I think he's happy.

speaker: dvm
text: That's great to hear. Next treatment is in one week, with bloodwork before.
